Quick notes on what to focus on:
- Week 0: technical validation (API keys, test data, basic latency checks)
- Week 1–2: feature validation (2–3 success stories / sample prompts)
- Week 3: acceptance tests (business KPIs, performance regression checks)
- Week 4: handoff & next-steps (license/commit discussion)

Hi Samantha — diving in below and adding a suggested timeline column to the matrix.

1) Prompt sets: we include a short canonical set of 10–15 prompts in the MAP doc under "Acceptance artifacts". They cover edge cases we commonly see for retrieval and summarization workflows. I'll paste a sanitized example into the gdoc before Tuesday.

2) Data-flow sketch: usually a separate 1-page diagram attached to the MAP (we keep it in the "Security/ops" folder). For your review, Ben can share a standard template (no customer data) so Priya can validate the flow and required controls.

3) Test inputs: preferred is that Olive provide up to 100 rows of representative examples (anonymized) for highest signal. If that's difficult, we can generate synthetic inputs that follow your data shape — results are generally comparable for initial validation but we note production differences in the MAP.

Proposed demo cadence:
- Tue 6/19 10:00am PT — 45m sync (technical + product)
- Thu 6/28 11:00am PT — quick checkpoint (results review)
- Fri 7/12 — final acceptance sign-off (if criteria met)

I'll update the GDoc now with an example prompt set and a timeline column. Alex — can you upload the data-flow sketch and the blank acceptance checklist as attachments?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
